title: A week at Institute
narrative: In November, Wynona traveled to Lancaster for a week of teachers’ institute lectures, music and friends. Her entries name the people she roomed with and the speakers she heard; they also record a persistent toothache.

The postcard shows Millersville State Normal School, where Beth says Wynona had trained. It gives the scene educational context, but the diary account places this institute week and lodging in Lancaster; the postcard should not be read as a photograph of that week.
evidenceNote: The month comes from candidate event E030. Beth’s transcription in P054 supplies daily entries from November 9–16, 1890. The school postcard is contextual archive material, not a dated image of Wynona’s trip.
